purpose: Prepare auditable data for content-linked memory motivation validation; no method evaluation or training

api.proxy_mode: explicit HTTPS_PROXY or https_proxy; ignore ALL_PROXY
api.base_url_policy: append /v1 only when configured URL has no path

split_policy: Video-MME videos are disjoint. No formal test selection until development calibration. All 300 long videos / 900 QA are inventoried.
annotation_policy: All model-produced reference facts and evidence labels are automatic proxies pending source verification and human audit. Keep unknowns and unsupported references.
visibility_policy: Questions, choices, answers and evidence annotations are evaluation-only. This run does not construct experimental memories.
modality_policy: Visual frames plus synchronized original dataset subtitles. Record visual/subtitle/mixed support separately; subtitles are not visual proof.
scope_policy: Global count, absence, first/last and exhaustive summary claims cannot be confirmed from a few retrieved clips. Record unresolved coverage. No human audits are claimed by automated scripts.
scope: Video-MME-long only, per user clarification; EgoLife excluded from this run
refinement_reason: Preserve run-003. Pooled lexical retrieval omitted individual steps; silent frames could not verify spoken facts. Rerun the SAME 12 preregistered QA with per-step/fact/reference annotation retrieval and source subtitles. No condition is selected by answer success; this is data calibration, not a method comparison.
